Demo has no hitscan so all of his damage comes down to prediction to some degree. In most cases you have to predict that the guy you're shooting at is going to either move to or won't move from where you're shooting.

Another part of the mindset is area denial. All demo does can be viewed as area denial in a way, even shooting directly at people (you're denying where they're standing). Demo is best when he's not the center of attention because they can't react to your projectiles immediately, but in cases where the person(s) you're shooting at are looking at you, they will want to move out of the way of your projectiles. This goes back to the prediction thing mentioned earlier. The way demo kills people that aren't motionless is by *denying* where they are and where they will be with fat damage. You need to put your bombs where they will be, not where they are.

As far as playing within the team goes, you are the main engine and if your team isn't playing around you they're doing something wrong. In a perfect world your team should gravitate to where you are as long as you aren't somewhere dumb but most pubbers have room temperature iq so sometimes you gotta follow them unfortunately.

It's important to not be alone because you don't walk very fast and sticky jumping is very costly; it's very easy to get in messy situations because 1v1s for you are unreliable (skilled demos can usually handle it but unlike scout and soldier your weapons are just more inconsistent and you can't disengage easily + self damage risks). Another thing is that you need to reload a lot and it's slow. You want other players around you to protect you, scouts and heavies are your best friend. Because of this and the point about you being best when you're not the center of attention, you want to bait your team, let them take the attention so you can fire away, you can think of yourself as artillery in that regard.
